hypothesis.description:
For a MARKET-NEUTRAL CARRY in BTC -- long BTC-USD spot, short the Hyperliquid perpetual at equal notional -- the mean forward carry return on days when funding stood ABOVE its own 30-day trailing average is HIGHER than on days when it stood at or below. Direction INCREASE pre-declared.

WHY A RELATIVE THRESHOLD AND NOT ZERO. The absolute version (Hypothesis #37) classifies by sign, and the inverted group holds 11 of 366 days in 2024 and 18 of 365 in 2025, with one walk-forward fold each year containing NONE -- so the validation can only answer INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and more data never fixes it because the split is degenerate at any length. funding_rate_surge_strategy documented that exact failure for the funding signal in September and fixed it by comparing the series to its own history; this carries the fix across to the exit rule. Measured split at this window: roughly 135/199 instead of 353/11.

THE WINDOW IS A REAL CONCESSION. Zero needed no parameter; a trailing average does. What makes it defensible is that comparing a series to its own history is a STRUCTURAL choice, and that this window was not picked because it worked: it was selected as the best of EIGHT candidates in sealed Discovery scan DISCOVERY_SCAN|c3fefc4d698d7ea9026d5837997f44e1009b26888960fb1909691b02f4c5a517, whose multiplicity is carried here and corrected for.

THE PERIOD IS THE HOLDOUT. The scan read 2024 and only 2024; 2025 was declared its holdout before the scan ran and was never loaded. This evaluation is out of sample by construction, not by promise. The one leak, stated: the 31-day warmup comes from December 2024 and feeds the INDICATOR, never the measured outcome.

The outcome is NOT a price change: it is the funding received over the period MINUS the change in basis, at 24 payments a day, which is what Hyperliquid actually pays. An earlier run of this family read that series as a daily rate when it is an hourly one, understating the funding leg 24-fold.

NO LOOKAHEAD: the row at t is classified by funding at t-1 against the 30 days before it, and the outcome reads t+1.

records.interpretation:
Regla de salida del carry BTC con UMBRAL RELATIVO, ventana 30, evaluada sobre el HOLDOUT 2025. Posicion neutral: largo spot, corto perpetuo de Hyperliquid, funding a 24 pagos diarios.

PROCEDENCIA: seleccionada como la mejor de 8 candidatas en un scan sellado de Discovery sobre 2024, y corregida por esa multiplicidad aqui. 2025 se declaro holdout antes del scan y el scan nunca lo leyo.

Resultado: metric=0.000195, grupos 152/213, criterio GT 0 -> ACCEPTED. Walk-forward 5/5 MET, consistencia 1.0, p binomial 0.03125 contra alfa corregida None -> NOT_VALIDATED.

LIMITES: valida la REGLA DE SALIDA, no si la prima compensa el riesgo -- esa es una afirmacion de nivel y vive en level_claim, donde el carry mantenido de forma continua ya quedo NOT_VALIDATED por romper el limite de drawdown en 2019-2021. Bruto de costes. Un venue, un instrumento, un ano. El warmup de 31 dias procede de diciembre de 2024, dentro de la ventana de descubrimiento, y alimenta el indicador, nunca el outcome medido.
limitations: THE TEST WAS UNPASSABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, and that is a property of the design, not of the result. With 5 folds the smallest attainable binomial p-value is (1/2)^5 = 0.03125, while Bonferroni over 8 candidates sets the bar at 0.05/8 = 0.00625. Every fold passing still misses it. A test corrected for N needs at least log2(20N) folds -- 8 for N=8 -- or no outcome can clear it. This was knowable before running and was not checked.

Validates the EXIT RULE, not whether the premium compensates the risk. That is a level claim, and level_claim already returned NOT_VALIDATED for the continuously held carry over 2019-2021 on a drawdown breach.
Single venue, single instrument, single year, single horizon.

The 31-day warmup comes from December 2024, inside the discovery window. It feeds the INDICATOR and never the measured outcome, but it is a leak of the signal's starting value and is stated rather than buried.
The window was selected as the best of eight on 2024. The correction for that is applied here; it does not make the selection disappear.

analytical_rule.lower_or_equal_group: funding_rate_t-1 <= CARRYSURGE30_t (the premium is thinner than usual)
analytical_rule.upper_group: funding_rate_t-1 > CARRYSURGE30_t (the premium is richer than usual)
